castle.roles: CombatArena for Frozen Foyer, Dust Bunny Cleanup, Claw Guardian, Dragon-Turtle Throne; DungeonPuzzleRoom for Crystal Chimes, Frozen River, Pepper Lanterns, Turtle Gallery, Moon Rune Vault, Elemental Door

ember.roles: CombatArena for Cinder Gate Imps, Ash Imp Ambush, The Molten Throne; DungeonPuzzleRoom for Lava Stepping Stones, Ember Chimes, Door of Fire and Ice

shared_dispatch.condition: PATHS and EMBER_PATHS are empty, so every listed room reaches fallback role cards; fallback is attached as Node3D crossed_card debt.

top_reuse_pairs.match: Exact basket object and transparent cutout; semantically safe for the shared Basket role.
top_reuse_pairs.gap: Pearl/jewel trim and glossy gradients require contextual style approval; do not regenerate or edit the source.
top_reuse_pairs.binding_guard: Use only for Basket, never for puzzle pictograms or targets; preserve touch geometry.

top_reuse_pairs.match: Complete transparent closed-door construction; semantically exact Door role.
top_reuse_pairs.gap: Highly ornamented fairy-conservatory styling may conflict with dungeon theme; inspect as a source candidate only and preserve the original.
top_reuse_pairs.binding_guard: Do not use the open variant as a generic door card; it contains a complete scene inside the doorway. Preserve door-open state semantics.

top_reuse_pairs.match: Complete 2D arena background with a readable central play floor; exact Arena scene function.
top_reuse_pairs.gap: This is a full-screen background, not a small crossed-card part. It cannot be bound directly to DungeonArt.spawn('arena') without a role-specific 2D adapter and contextual scale check.
top_reuse_pairs.binding_guard: Reuse only as arena background if source consumer accepts a Canvas/TextureRect; do not mount as Sprite3D or crop arbitrary UV regions.

safe_reuse_rejects.reason: Opaque QA image with low-poly rendered stones on a flat field; not a runtime transparent card and not approved as final true-2D art.
Opaque QA image with low-poly rendered lantern on a flat field; source candidate only, no runtime binding.
Native inspection is an all-white opaque image; it is not a usable door card.
Native inspection shows raw UV/texture maps. Never treat these as finished cards.
Diamond/orb/triangle/ice/flame/moon/star/question/left/right/pepper are deliberate child-readable stimuli; primitive construction alone is not a defect.

bounded_jobs.scope: Review the three conditional candidates in active room captures; select only semantically matching cards and keep source provenance.
bounded_jobs.forbidden: No blanket replacement, no UV cropping, no Sprite3D addition, no geometry or touch-region changes.

bounded_jobs.scope: If approved, replace one shared fallback role at a time and capture all castle/Ember consumers before proceeding.
bounded_jobs.forbidden: Do not map a flower to a pepper, a pine to a triangle, or a generic star to a role-specific object merely to fill PATHS.

provenance: Runtime assets are existing repository sources. assets_src QA/concept files are review evidence only until owner approves provenance and a runtime-safe derived card. Protected book/friend sources remain immutable.
